summary: Ukrainian air defenses shot down or suppressed 70 enemy targets overnight on 18 July, including one Kh-59/69 missile and 69 Shahed-type drones, amid a large-scale attack on Odesa region. Russia struck a foreign-flagged merchant vessel in the Black Sea near Odesa, killing one and wounding three. Russian drone and missile threats persisted across northern, eastern, and southern Ukraine with multiple ballistic launch warnings from Bryansk and Rostov.
key_points: Ukrainian forces shot down or suppressed 70 enemy targets overnight 18 July, including one Kh-59/69 missile and 69 Shahed-type drones across north, south, east (Source: @kpszsu/68985).
Russia attacked a merchant vessel under Antigua and Barbuda flag in Odesa region, killing one and wounding three, with a repeat strike damaging rescue equipment (Source: @UkraineNow/82743).
Enemy launched two Iskander-M ballistic and two Oniks anti-ship missiles plus 90 Shahed-type drones at Ukraine from Crimea and Russian directions (Source: @kpszsu/68985).
Mon1tor_ua warned of high threat of Iskander-M ballistic launches from Bryansk and Taganrog, Rostov region on 18 July (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69124).
Russia struck civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv's Shevchenkivskyi district, killing a 40-year-old man and wounding 9 including two children (Source: @UkraineNow/82734).
Recon and strike drones were tracked over Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia and Odesa regions from northern and Black Sea directions (Source: @eRadarrua/101514).
Russia double-struck a locomotive and passenger cars of a train in Zaporizhzhia region; no casualties reported per minister (Source: @UkraineNow/82744).
Ukrainian drones hit Wildberries sorting centers in Tambov and Elektrostal and an oil depot in Noginsk, with 7 dead in Tambov per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101494).

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian air defenses shot down or suppressed 70 enemy targets overnight on 18 July, including one Kh-59/69 missile and 69 Shahed-type drones, during a mass attack primarily aimed at Odesa region. Russia struck a foreign merchant vessel in the Black Sea off Odesa, killing one and wounding three, and hit civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv killing a 40-year-old man. Multiple ballistic missile launch threats from Bryansk and Rostov regions were issued amid continued drone activity across northern and southern fronts.

points: Ukrainian Air Force reported on night of 18 July enemy attacked with two Iskander-M ballistic missiles from TOT AR Crimea, two Oniks anti-ship missiles from TOT AR Crimea, three Kh-59/69 guided missiles from Crimea airspace, and 90 Shahed-type drones from Bryansk, Orel, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, TOT Donetsk, Gvardeyskoye directions; 70 targets shot down/suppressed (Source: @kpszsu/68985).

President Zelensky appointed Oleksandr Poklad as acting head of SBU via decree 622/2026; Poklad is SBU major-general, former deputy chief of counterintelligence, and was recommended by Andriy Yermak (Source: @UkraineNow/82735).

Cabinet appointed Maksym Tsutsikidze as acting head of National Police; previous head Ivan Vyhivskyi was named interior minister; Tsutsikidze was first deputy and cited in 2021 Bihus.Info as kum of deputy head of Presidential Office Oleg Tatarov (Source: @UkraineNow/82736).
Zelensky proposed Ihor Klymenko position of secretary of RNBO; relevant decree being prepared (Source: @UkraineNow/82725).

DBR suspected deputy commander of military unit in Zaporizhzhia and his civilian wife of fraudulent 1.3 million UAH combat payments; wife held Russian passport until 2026; both face up to 10 years (Source: @UkraineNow/82726).
Zelensky stated all SBU and foreign intelligence archives on 20th century Volyn events will be opened and more exhumation permits issued after meeting on Poland direction (Source: @UkraineNow/82732).
Russian MoD stated near Zmiinyi Island a dry cargo ship carrying cargo for AFU was struck at sea and in Port Chernomorsk a container ship unloading ammunition was hit (Source: @tass_agency/385822).
Over 370 drones flew toward Moscow region from 20:30 Friday; most neutralized on distant approaches per Sobyanin (Source: @tass_agency/385821).

Tambov Wildberries sorting center and Elektrostal facility attacked by Ukrainian drones; 7 night-shift employees died in Tambov and one person died in Elektrostal per Vorobyov (Source: @eRadarrua/101494, @tass_agency/385847).
Oil depot Inter-Transproduct in Noginsk, Moscow region, destroyed by drones; large smoke clouds covered Moscow region per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101495).
Tatyana Kim called attacks on Wildberries logistics centers in Tambov and Moscow regions awful and promised help to all affected (Source: @tass_agency/385840).
TASS reported orange danger level in Moscow for over a day due to heat up to +30C; unrelated to combat (Source: @tass_agency/385850).

Kharkiv region: ballistic weapons threat declared by kpszsu on 18 July; eRadarrua tracked recon drone over Snovsk and strike drone toward Kharkiv (Kutuzivka) (Source: @kpszsu/68978, @eRadarrua/101483).

Kharkiv Shevchenkivskyi district rocket strike killed 40-year-old man, wounded 9 including 7-year-old boy with explosive wounds and 2-year-old with stress reaction; school and buildings damaged (Source: @UkraineNow/82734).
Dnipropetrovsk region: enemy attacked almost 40 times on 17 July with drones and aerial bombs per UkraineNow summary (Source: @UkraineNow/82737).

Zaporizhzhia region: reactive drone headed toward Komyshuvakha from south per kpszsu; Russia double-struck locomotive and passenger cars, no casualties per minister (Source: @kpszsu/68997, @UkraineNow/82744).
eRadarrua noted drones circling over Dnipropetrovsk region on 18 July with vague forecast of imminent strike (Source: @eRadarrua/101469).
Eastern Chernihiv: reactive drone tracked southwest course per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68974).

Chernihiv region: eRadarrua tracked recon drone over Snovsk and reactive drones north of Ripky, north of Kholmiv, toward Ripky and Horodnia; kpszsu tracked reactive drone east Chernihiv southwest (Source: @eRadarrua/101483, @eRadarrua/101512, @kpszsu/68974).
Sumy region: two strike drones from north toward Sumy and one recon drone over Shostka per eRadarrua; kpszsu reported drones from north (Source: @eRadarrua/101514, @kpszsu/68954).
Bryansk region: mon1tor_ua warned of missile launch from Bryansk and high threat of Iskander-M ballistic launch from Bryansk on 18 July (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69126, @mon1tor_ua/69124).
No specific northern-front ground engagements stated; all messages refer to drone tracks and ballistic launch warnings from Russian border directions.

Odesa region: main attack direction per kpszsu; reactive drone toward Vylkove from Black Sea and toward Chernomorsk from Black Sea; Russia struck foreign vessel killing one, wounding three (Source: @kpszsu/68958, @UkraineNow/82743).
Black Sea: mon1tor_ua reported ballistics on Chornomorsk; kpszsu reported reactive drone toward Odesa from Black Sea (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69122, @kpszsu/68954).
Kherson: eRadarrua tracked three guided drones past Kherson westbound repeating route to Odesa (Source: @eRadarrua/101503).
Zaporizhzhia south: reactive drone toward Komyshuvakha from south; Russia double strike on train noted (Source: @kpszsu/68997, @UkraineNow/82744).
MoD RF claimed dry cargo near Zmiinyi and container ship in Chernomorsk port hit (Source: @tass_agency/385822).

Night 18 July: enemy used 2 Iskander-M, 2 Oniks, 3 Kh-59/69, 90 Shahed/Gerbera/Italmas/Banderol/Parodya drones; Ukraine shot down/suppressed 70 including 69 drones and one Kh-59/69; hits on 19 locations, debris on 5 (Source: @kpszsu/68985).
kpszsu later announced cancellation of ballistic threat after earlier warnings for Kharkiv and general (Source: @kpszsu/68959, @kpszsu/68978).
mon1tor_ua issued Iskander-M threats from Bryansk and Taganrog Rostov on 18 July (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69125, @mon1tor_ua/69124).
Over 370 drones toward Moscow region from Friday 20:30; most neutralized far out per Sobyanin (Source: @tass_agency/385821).
Ukrainian drones hit Wildberries Tambov/Elektrostal and Noginsk oil depot; 7 dead Tambov, 1 dead Elektrostal (Source: @eRadarrua/101494, @tass_agency/385847).
Reactive drones tracked from Black Sea toward Vylkove and Odesa; three guided drones past Kherson west (Source: @kpszsu/68958, @eRadarrua/101503).

key_developments: Ukraine shot down/suppressed 70 targets night 18 July including 69 Shahed-type drones and one Kh-59/69 missile; enemy used 90 drones and 7 missiles from Crimea and Russia (Source: @kpszsu/68985).
Russia struck Antigua-Barbuda flagged merchant in Odesa region killing one, wounding three, then repeat strike damaged rescue tech; port infrastructure hit (Source: @UkraineNow/82743).
Iskander-M ballistic launch threats declared from Bryansk and Taganrog Rostov by mon1tor_ua on 18 July amid active drone war (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69124).
Kharkiv Shevchenkivskyi rocket strike killed 40-year-old man and wounded 9 including two children; school and admin buildings damaged (Source: @UkraineNow/82734).
Ukrainian drones destroyed Wildberries centers in Tambov (7 dead) and Elektrostal and Noginsk oil depot in Moscow region (Source: @eRadarrua/101494).
Zelensky appointed Oleksandr Poklad acting SBU head and proposed Klymenko as RNBO secretary; Tsutsikidze named acting police head (Source: @UkraineNow/82735).
Russia double-struck train locomotive and passenger cars in Zaporizhzhia; all evacuated safely, no casualties per infrastructure minister (Source: @UkraineNow/82744).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian missile and drone campaign intensified on 18 July with 90 Shahed-type drones and seven missiles aimed chiefly at Odesa, while ballistic launch warnings from Bryansk and Taganrog indicate continued strategic strike capability. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 70 targets but 19 impact locations and 5 debris sites show penetration risk to civilian and port infrastructure. Russian strikes on foreign vessels in the Black Sea elevate risk to third-country shipping and NATO-adjacent escalation. Ukrainian long-range drone hits on Russian logistics and fuel sites in Tambov, Elektrostal and Noginsk demonstrate reciprocal deep-strike reach.
sections.regional_response: Poland recorded a 30% rise in xenophobic crimes against Ukrainians with 180 reports this year, straining bilateral society ties amid Zelensky's pledge to open SBU archives on Volyn events and expand exhumations. Ukraine appointed new SBU and police leadership and proposed RNBO secretary change, signaling internal security restructuring during war. No state military response from neighbors was stated, but attacks on Black Sea shipping under Antigua flag may prompt diplomatic pressure on Russia from flag states.
sections.intelligence_notes: Open-source radar channels (eRadarrua, mon1tor_ua, kpszsu) provided real-time drone and ballistic warnings across north, east and south, showing distributed early-warning coverage. DBR investigation of Zaporizhzhia deputy commander and wife with Russian passport reveals counterintelligence concern over dual citizens in military payroll. Ukrainian leadership changes at SBU and National Police under Zelensky and Ermak recommendation suggest centralized control of security apparatus. DeepStateUA and ukr_leaks note protests over Syrskyi and Fedorov dismissal, reflecting internal military-political friction.
